title: BackendRuntimeSecretsEnvelope (backend-runtime-v1)
description: JSON shape of an AWS Secrets Manager SecretString for backend runtime secrets. Deploy materializes this envelope onto host env files, optional config secret overlays, structured OAuth material, custom provider entries, and optional opaque files. Backends only read the resulting files; they do not parse this envelope. Secret values must never appear in git, tfvars, or Terraform outputs.

schema_version.description: Envelope document schema major. Bump only with breaking changes to this file's shape. Additive optional fields (oauth, custom_providers, files) stay on const 1.

kind_hint.description: Optional documentation / validation hint for the intended backend kind. Materialize must not refuse the envelope when kind_hint is absent or differs from BACKEND_KIND — the envelope is backend-neutral.

env.description: Process environment name → secret value. Keys are env names backends already understand. Recommended multi-provider set (include only active slots in live SM; full matrix with placeholders is fine in git templates): OPENAI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, LITELLM_MASTER_KEY (Agent/LiteLLM), LANYARD_OAUTH_KEY (Agent OAuth store), META_API_KEY / other custom provider key_env names, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, GATEWAY_RELAY_SECRET, FIRECRAWL_API_KEY (agent web crawl/scrape; cost-gated — omit unless live Firecrawl enabled), X_BEARER_TOKEN (optional X/Twitter search), TAVILY_API_KEY / BRAVE_API_KEY (optional web search). Values are plaintext secrets only inside SM / on-host materialize outputs (mode 0600).

oauth.description: Optional structured OAuth material for known model providers. Keys are provider ids. Known ids: xai-grok (Agent Super Heavy / SuperGrok), xai-oauth (Hermes Super Heavy provider id), openai-codex (Hermes + Agent Codex device-code). Placeholders (oauth-placeholder-…, REPLACE_ME…) are allowed in git templates; materialize may skip writing a provider when the token is a placeholder sentinel. Materialize projects structured oauth into host stores: hermes_lanyard/hermes_upstream → $HERMES_HOME/auth.json; lanyard_agent → $BACKEND_HOME/oauth.enc (with LANYARD_OAUTH_KEY in env). Prefer opaque files[] when exporting an already-formed auth store blob.

custom_providers.description: Optional ordered list of N custom OpenAI-compatible backends (Meta, corp proxies, etc.). Aligns with Hermes config providers.<id> / custom_providers[] (base_url, key_env|api_key) and LiteLLM model_list api_base + api_key os.environ/<KEY>. Prefer api_key_env / key_env so the secret value lives only in env; inline api_key is allowed for SM-only overlays when env indirection is impossible. Materialize may project entries into config.secrets.yaml and ensure matching env keys.

config_secret_overlay.description: Optional deep-merge overlay for secret-bearing config keys only (never non-secrets-only content). Materialize writes this to a secret overlay file (e.g. config.secrets.yaml) or merges secret keys into config.yaml. Prefer env + key_env / api_key_env for provider credentials when possible. Example shapes: providers.<id>.{base_url, key_env} or custom_providers[] with key_env (non-secret base_url may stay in public config.yaml).

files.description: Optional opaque secret files written relative to BACKEND_HOME / HERMES_HOME. v1 multi-provider allowlist: auth.json (Hermes OAuth store), oauth.enc (Agent encrypted OAuth store). Reject absolute paths and '..' segments. Prefer this when operators export a full auth store offline; use structured oauth when injecting per-provider tokens instead.

meta.description: Non-authoritative operator metadata (tenant slug, rotation timestamps). Not consumed by backends at runtime.

notes.description: Free-form operator note (never put secret values here).

oauthProviderMaterial.description: Per-provider OAuth tokens + optional metadata. openai-codex should set metadata.chatgpt_account_id (ChatGPT-Account-Id) when Hermes/Agent expect it.

access_token.description: OAuth access token (or placeholder sentinel in git templates).

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token when the provider issues one.

expires_at.description: Access-token expiry as ISO-8601 datetime or epoch seconds string.

metadata.description: Provider-specific non-token fields (account labels, ChatGPT-Account-Id). Never put tokens here.

customProviderEntry.description: One custom OpenAI-compatible provider. Prefer api_key_env or key_env over inline api_key.

id.description: Provider id (Hermes providers.<id> / LiteLLM model_list naming root).

api_key_env.description: Env var name holding the API key (preferred). Value must also appear under envelope env when materializing.

api_key.description: Inline API key. Prefer api_key_env/key_env. Allowed for SM-only overlays; git templates must use placeholders only.

default_model.description: Default model id for this provider.

models.description: Optional model id allowlist for this provider.

secretFileEntry.description: Opaque secret file relative to BACKEND_HOME/HERMES_HOME. Provide content (utf-8) or content_base64.

path_relative.description: Relative path only (no leading '/', no '..'). v1 allowlist: auth.json, oauth.enc.

encoding.description: How to interpret content fields. Default utf-8 when content is set; base64 when content_base64 is set.

content.description: UTF-8 file body (e.g. Hermes auth.json JSON text).

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded body (e.g. Agent oauth.enc binary store).

hermes_lanyard.unit_environment_file: EnvironmentFile include secrets (merge into .env or second EnvironmentFile)

hermes_upstream.unit_environment_file: EnvironmentFile include secrets (same Hermes home layout)

lanyard_agent.oauth_target: $BACKEND_HOME/oauth.enc (from oauth and/or files[] path_relative=oauth.enc) + LANYARD_OAUTH_KEY in env
lanyard_agent.custom_providers_target: LiteLLM model_list api_base seed (public) + env api keys; optional config.secrets.yaml

x-lanyard-placeholder-policy.description: Committed examples must use obvious placeholders only (sk-placeholder-…, REPLACE_ME, oauth-placeholder-…). Never real API keys, refresh tokens, or customer account material. Live SM omits unused slots entirely rather than shipping sentinels.

x-lanyard-recommended-env-keys.description: Teaching set for full-matrix templates. Live SM includes only active keys. Web-search slots (FIRECRAWL_API_KEY, X_BEARER_TOKEN, TAVILY_API_KEY, BRAVE_API_KEY) are optional and cost-gated — omit from live SM until the pilot intentionally enables that provider (lp-uxy.7).
